label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — The resolved sink value on the executed path is attacker-controlled. User input flows from request cookies -> URL decoding -> conditional assignment to 'param' -> guard condition '(500/42)+196 > 200' evaluates to TRUE -> 'bar' assigned 'param'. 'bar' becomes the input to MessageDigest hashing, resulting in 'input' being derived from user data. Finally, 'new String(input)' is passed to ESAPI.encoder().encodeForHTML(...), which writes directly to response.getWriter(). Although ESAPI encoding is present, the sink expression itself receives attacker-controlled data ('bar') which has been transformed into bytes and re-stringified, meaning the XSS payload survives the transformation and reaches the HTML sink. The guard ensures user input always reaches the sink.

evidence.note: Guard condition (500/42)+num > 200 evaluates to true (196+196=392>200), causing bar to be assigned the user-provided param.
Sink expression: encodeForHTML(new String(input)) printed to writer. Input derives from bar (which equals param), confirming attacker-controlled data reaches the HTML sink.
